prompt:
超写实室内楼梯人像摄影，竖版 9:16，一名明确成年的东亚女性，20+，坐在现代极简楼梯的黑色台阶上。采用约 35–50mm 等效镜头，摄影者位于人物正前方略偏左、接近腰部高度，完整拍到头部、上半身、交叠双腿和赤脚，同时保留大面积向左上延伸的黑色楼梯与右侧白墙，人物位于画面右下区域，留出明显环境空间。

人物为中小骨架、自然纤细沙漏型身材，肩部偏窄，腰部收束，髋部自然圆润，大腿有真实柔软体积，小腿修长。坐在较低一级台阶上，背部轻靠右侧白墙，一条腿从另一条腿上方高位交叉，膝盖抬起；另一条腿沿楼梯向左下方长距离伸展，形成明显的斜向腿部线条。双脚赤脚，不穿鞋。

人物留乌黑色超长直发＋厚重齐刘海，头发长度到腰部以下，发量浓密、顺直，两侧长发垂在胸前和身体两边。头部轻微向右倾斜，双眼直视镜头，表情安静、冷淡。左手弯曲抬到耳侧 / 后颈附近，右手抬到肩部轻触头发，动作自然克制。

上身穿纯黑色修身长袖连体衣 / bodysuit，整体紧贴身体。胸口有非常醒目的椭圆形镂空＋黑色交叉绑带结构：从锁骨下方向胸口延伸多组 X 形细带，并带少量金属圆环、金色小挂饰；领口处还有一圈黑色结构化颈带 / 小披肩式领片。衣服整体为哑光弹力面料，袖子修身，不要蕾丝大面积装饰。

双腿穿烟黑色超薄高光连裤丝袜，约 10–15D，透明度高，明显透出自然肤色。丝袜具有非常强的丝光 / 油亮反射，尤其在膝盖、小腿胫骨和大腿外侧形成连续的银灰色高光带；脚部也完整包裹，但脚趾处为透明薄袜结构，能清楚看到脚趾轮廓。不要网袜、厚黑丝袜或哑光袜。

场景为极简现代楼梯间：楼梯全部为黑色或深炭灰色水泥 / 木质踏步，表面略有使用痕迹和不均匀反光；右侧为大面积纯白或浅灰白墙面，几乎没有装饰。楼梯向画面左上方延伸，顶部有一个小型黑框窗户，透入少量冷白自然光。空间整体高挑、安静、偏冷。

光线采用正面柔和补光 / 弱直闪＋顶部窗户自然光。人物脸部和皮肤明亮偏冷白，黑色衣服保持细节，丝袜高光非常明显；楼梯深黑，白墙形成强烈黑白对比。不要强烈电影灯光，不要彩色霓虹。

整体呈 高质量手机 / 无反相机室内时尚写真质感：自然锐度、轻微冷色调、有限景深但环境仍清楚，肤质真实，不要塑料磨皮。

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋超长黑直发厚齐刘海＋黑色长袖镂空绑带连体衣＋烟黑超薄高光丝袜＋赤脚＋楼梯坐姿＋一腿高位交叉、一腿沿台阶向前伸展＋双手分别靠近耳侧和肩部＋黑色楼梯＋纯白墙＋人物位于画面右下＋冷白极简室内。

避免：短发、卷发、裸腿、网袜、厚黑丝袜、鞋子、高跟鞋、站姿、双腿并拢、普通黑裙、彩色服装、复杂室内装饰、暖黄色豪华酒店、强背景虚化、动漫脸、CG 感、多余肢体、水印和乱码文字。

promptTranslations.en:
Ultra-realistic indoor staircase portrait photography, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio, a clearly adult East Asian female in her 20s, sitting on the black steps of a modern minimalist staircase. Shot with an equivalent 35–50mm lens, the camera is positioned slightly to the left directly in front of the subject at approximately waist height, fully capturing the head, upper body, crossed legs, and bare feet, while preserving a large area of the black staircase extending toward the upper left and the white wall on the right; the subject is located in the lower-right area of the frame, leaving noticeable environmental negative space.

The subject has a small-to-medium frame with a natural, slender hourglass figure—narrower shoulders, cinched waist, naturally rounded hips, thighs with realistic soft volume, and elongated slender calves. She sits on a lower step with her back lightly leaning against the white wall on the right, one leg crossed high over the other with the knee raised, while the other leg extends a long distance diagonally downward to the left along the stairs, creating a distinct diagonal leg line. Both feet are barefoot, wearing no shoes.

The subject has jet-black ultra-long straight hair with thick, blunt-cut straight bangs; hair length reaches below the waist, thick, dense, and sleek, with long locks hanging over the chest and down both sides of the body. Her head is tilted slightly to the right, looking directly into the camera lens with a calm, aloof expression. Her left arm is bent and raised near her ear/nape, while her right hand is raised near the shoulder lightly touching her hair, in a natural and restrained pose.

She wears a solid black, form-fitting long-sleeved bodysuit that hugs the body tightly throughout. The chest features a highly prominent oval cut-out accented by a black criss-cross strappy cage structure: multiple sets of thin X-shaped straps extend from below the collarbone toward the bust, adorned with a few metal rings and small gold charms; at the neckline sits a black structured choker collar / capelet-style neckline piece. The outfit is made of matte stretch fabric with slim sleeves, avoiding large areas of lace decoration.

Her legs are clad in smoke-black ultra-thin high-gloss pantyhose, approximately 10–15 denier, highly sheer, clearly revealing natural skin tone beneath. The pantyhose have an intense lustrous/oily sheen, forming continuous silver-gray highlight streaks especially along the knees, shins, and outer thighs; the feet are also fully encased, but sheer at the toes so that the contours of the toes are clearly visible. No fishnets, no thick opaque black tights, no matte stockings.

The scene is a minimalist modern stairwell: all stairs are made of black or dark charcoal-gray concrete/wood treads with slight traces of wear and uneven reflections; to the right is a large expanse of pure white or pale off-white wall, virtually unadorned. The staircase ascends toward the upper left of the frame, with a small black-framed window at the top admitting a small amount of cool-white natural light. The overall space is high-ceilinged, quiet, and cool-toned.

Lighting consists of a soft frontal fill light / weak direct flash combined with natural light from the top window. The subject's face and skin are bright with a cool-white cast, details in the black clothing are well-preserved, and the pantyhose highlights are very pronounced; the stairs are deep black, while the white wall establishes a stark black-and-white contrast. No intense cinematic colored lighting, no neon colors.

Overall visual aesthetic resembles a high-quality smartphone/mirrorless camera indoor fashion portrait: natural sharpness, slight cool tone, limited depth of field yet the environment remains discernible, realistic skin texture without plastic-smooth airbrushing.

Key anchors: adult East Asian woman + ultra-long straight black hair with thick blunt bangs + black long-sleeved cut-out strappy bodysuit + smoke-black ultra-thin high-gloss pantyhose + barefoot + sitting pose on stairs + one leg crossed high, one leg extended forward along the steps + hands positioned near ear and shoulder respectively + black staircase + pure white wall + subject positioned in lower-right of frame + cool-white minimalist interior.

Avoid: short hair, curly hair, bare legs, fishnets, thick opaque black tights, shoes, high heels, standing pose, legs pressed together, ordinary black dress, colorful clothing, complex interior decor, warm yellow luxury hotel, heavy background bokeh blur, anime face, CG look, extra limbs, watermarks, and garbled text.

summaryTranslations.en: Realistic portrait prompt of an adult East Asian woman in a minimalist black staircase and white wall space, emphasizing the cut-out bodysuit, glossy pantyhose, and seated composition.
